notes.title: Build a floating neighborhood with your friends in this vibrant MMO life sim that crowdfunded over $1.2 million
notes.content: Spending hours passing the time in a colorful life sim by farming, crafting, decorating, and exploring is great—but it's even better with some friends along for the ride. In upcoming cozy MMO Loftia, that's just what you'll do: build a house on a floating island in the sky and connect it up with your friends' cozy homes. Then build, craft, farm, and explore the world together... Read more.
